description: F0b RBAC layer: rework the auth store to carry the real JWT claims (roles/permissions/permissionsVersion/membershipId/institutionId) via jwt-decode with a persist version bump + migrate; add can()/useCan/<Can> + hasRole/hasAnyRole typed on PermissionKey; add RouteGuard + shared UX-state components; add the module-active probe; add the permission/role-based login landing (replacing the 5-way role switch, SUPER_ADMIN -> /platform, legacy GatePass roles resolved BEFORE permission landings); and add the permission-driven AppShell + nav + the (app) route group. Depends on FEAT-001 (providers, shadcn primitives, ES2020). Must NOT break the five GatePass layouts or the MFA modal.
steps: Create apps/web/src/lib/jwt.ts: export interface AuthClaims { userId: string; membershipId: string|null; institutionId: string|null; roles: string[]; permissions: string[]; permissionsVersion: number|null; role: string; jti: string; exp?: number; iat?: number } and export function decodeAuthClaims(token: string): Partial<AuthClaims> { try { return jwtDecode<AuthClaims>(token) } catch { return {} } } (jwtDecode from jwt-decode).

Rewrite apps/web/src/stores/auth.ts per design §3.1: widen UserInfo.role from the 5-union to string (keeps GatePass user.role==="STUDENT" guards compiling); add roles: string[], permissions: string[], permissionsVersion: number|null, membershipId: string|null, institutionId: string|null to AuthState with initial []/[]/null/null/null; setAuth(token,user) calls decodeAuthClaims(token) and sets token,user plus roles/permissions/permissionsVersion/membershipId/institutionId (?? [] / ?? null) in ONE set; logout() clears token,user AND all five RBAC fields; keep setHydrated(); persist config keeps name:"campusgate-auth", adds version:1 and migrate:(persisted, fromVersion) => fromVersion < 1 ? { token:null, user:null, roles:[], permissions:[], permissionsVersion:null, membershipId:null, institutionId:null } : (persisted as Partial<AuthState>); add partialize persisting exactly {token,user,roles,permissions,permissionsVersion,membershipId,institutionId} (exclude hydrated); keep onRehydrateStorage => state => state?.setHydrated(). Import PermissionKey type if used.

Create apps/web/src/lib/authz.ts: pure can(permission: PermissionKey, perms: string[]): boolean = perms.includes(permission); canAny(permissions: PermissionKey[], perms: string[]); hasRole(role: string, roles: string[]); hasAnyRole(wanted: string[], roles: string[]); and store-reading hooks useCan(permission: PermissionKey), useCanAny(permissions: PermissionKey[]), useHasRole(role: string) that read useAuthStore selectors. PermissionKey imported from @campusgate/shared.

Create apps/web/src/components/auth/Can.tsx ("use client"): export function Can({ permission, anyOf, fallback=null, children }: { permission?: PermissionKey; anyOf?: PermissionKey[]; fallback?: React.ReactNode; children: React.ReactNode }) reading const perms = useAuthStore(s => s.permissions); allowed = permission ? perms.includes(permission) : anyOf ? anyOf.some(p=>perms.includes(p)) : false; return allowed ? <>{children}</> : <>{fallback}</>.

Create apps/web/src/components/ui-ext/EmptyState.tsx (lucide icon + label + description + optional action node, role="status") and apps/web/src/components/ui-ext/InlineError.tsx (danger panel reusing the .bg-danger-50 idiom, role="alert", takes a message string).

Create apps/web/src/components/auth/FullPageSkeleton.tsx (centered shadcn Skeleton layout) and apps/web/src/components/auth/ForbiddenScreen.tsx (friendly 'You don't have access to this page' with a Link back to /).

Create apps/web/src/components/auth/RouteGuard.tsx ("use client") per §3.7: props { requirePermission?: PermissionKey; children }. Read {token,user,hydrated,permissions} from useAuthStore. useEffect: if(!hydrated) return; if(!token||!user) router.replace('/login'). Render: if(!hydrated) <FullPageSkeleton/>; if(!token||!user) null; if(requirePermission && !permissions.includes(requirePermission)) <ForbiddenScreen/>; else children.

Create apps/web/src/features/modules/useModuleActive.ts per §3.3: useModuleActive(moduleKey: ModuleKey) returns 'active'|'inactive'|'forbidden'|'unknown'. Pick the probe from the store permissions: if can('fees.view') probe api.get('/api/fees/structures'); else if can('fees.view_own') probe api.get('/api/fees/me/outstanding'); else return 'unknown' (skip). Wrap in useQuery keyed ['module-active', moduleKey] with staleTime 5*60*1000, retry false. Classify: HTTP 200 -> 'active'; on ApiError 403, if err.data.error startsWith 'Module not active' -> 'inactive' else -> 'forbidden'; anything else (5xx/network/no error) -> 'unknown'. Only 'inactive' is the suppressing signal.

Create apps/web/src/lib/landing.ts: export function landingRoute(roles: string[], permissions: string[]): string with EXACT ORDER (design §3.6): 1) roles.includes('SUPER_ADMIN') -> '/platform'; 2) legacy GatePass roles FIRST — STUDENT->'/student', HOD->'/hod', GUARD->'/guard', ADMIN->'/admin'; 3) then permission-driven — if any of ['fees.view','fees.charges.manage','fees.structures.manage','fees.collect'] in permissions -> '/app/fees'; else if permissions.includes('fees.view_own') -> '/app/fees/me'; 4) default '/app'. (Order is load-bearing: ROLE_PERMISSIONS.STUDENT holds fees.view_own and ADMIN holds the fees staff set, so legacy roles MUST resolve before permissions or GatePass users get hijacked.)

Rewrite apps/web/src/app/login/page.tsx handleLogin: after setAuth(data.token, data.user), read const { roles, permissions } = useAuthStore.getState(); router.push(landingRoute(roles, permissions)). Remove the 5-way switch. Leave the form markup, Google placeholder, and register link unchanged.

Rewrite apps/web/src/app/page.tsx post-hydration guard: replace the 5-way switch with router.replace(landingRoute(useAuthStore.getState().roles, useAuthStore.getState().permissions)); keep the no-token -> /login branch and the 'Loading...' pulse while !hydrated.

Create apps/web/src/components/shell/AppShell.tsx ("use client") per §3.5: sidebar + topbar + content. Define const NAV: NavItem[] where NavItem = { href: string; label: string; icon: LucideIcon; anyOf: PermissionKey[]; module?: ModuleKey }, with entries { href:'/app/fees', label:'Fees', icon:Wallet, anyOf:['fees.view','fees.charges.manage','fees.structures.manage','fees.collect'], module:'fees' } and { href:'/app/fees/me', label:'My Fees', icon:Wallet, anyOf:['fees.view_own'], module:'fees' }. Render an item iff canAny(item.anyOf, perms) AND (!item.module || useModuleActive(item.module) !== 'inactive'). Active state via usePathname() startsWith. Topbar: generic 'Institution' label (NEVER the institutionId UUID), user.email + a coarse roles[0] badge, <NotificationBell/>, a button opening the existing <MfaEnrollment/> modal (reused verbatim), and a logout button (logout() then router.replace('/login')). Mobile bottom nav for <= md mirroring the GatePass idiom (bg-primary-50 text-primary-700 active). Call connectSocket() in a useEffect on mount.

Create apps/web/src/app/(app)/layout.tsx ("use client") rendering <RouteGuard><AppShell>{children}</AppShell></RouteGuard>. (app) is a route GROUP — it is NOT part of the URL; routes resolve at /app/... only if a /app path is used; note the fees routes live under (app)/fees so their URL is /app/fees per the NAV hrefs — ensure the group directory layout matches design §3.9 ((app)/fees/...).
acceptance_criteria: stores/auth.ts exposes roles/permissions/permissionsVersion/membershipId/institutionId; setAuth decodes the JWT; logout clears all RBAC fields; persist has version:1 + migrate returning the cleared slice for fromVersion<1; partialize excludes hydrated.
lib/authz.ts exports can/canAny/hasRole/hasAnyRole + useCan/useCanAny/useHasRole with permission params typed PermissionKey (a bogus key is a compile error).

components/auth/Can.tsx, RouteGuard.tsx, FullPageSkeleton.tsx, ForbiddenScreen.tsx; components/ui-ext/EmptyState.tsx, InlineError.tsx; features/modules/useModuleActive.ts; lib/jwt.ts; lib/landing.ts; components/shell/AppShell.tsx; app/(app)/layout.tsx all exist.
login/page.tsx and page.tsx use landingRoute (no 5-way switch); landingRoute resolves legacy GatePass roles BEFORE permission landings and SUPER_ADMIN->/platform.
The five GatePass layouts (admin/guard/hod/student/platform) and components/MfaEnrollment.tsx are unchanged and still compile against role: string.
npm run lint -w @campusgate/web passes and npm run build -w @campusgate/web succeeds.
verification: npm run lint -w @campusgate/web   (strict tsc — passes; GatePass role guards still compile)
npm run build -w @campusgate/web   (next build — succeeds; /platform and all five GatePass groups still build untouched)
findings:
RBAC foundation complete. Files added: lib/jwt.ts (decodeAuthClaims via jwt-decode), lib/authz.ts (can/canAny/hasRole/hasAnyRole + useCan/useCanAny/useHasRole, PermissionKey-typed), lib/landing.ts (landingRoute, legacy roles before permission landings, SUPER_ADMIN->/platform), components/auth/{Can,RouteGuard,FullPageSkeleton,ForbiddenScreen}.tsx, components/ui-ext/{EmptyState,InlineError}.tsx, components/shell/AppShell.tsx, features/modules/useModuleActive.ts, app/(app)/layout.tsx. Rewrote stores/auth.ts (persist version:1 + migrate clearing pre-v1 sessions, partialize excludes hydrated, UserInfo.role widened to string), login/page.tsx + page.tsx (landingRoute replaces 5-way switch).

Notes for later FEATs:
- AppShell NAV already declares the two fees entries (/app/fees staff, /app/fees/me student). Fees pages must live under app/(app)/fees/* so URLs resolve to /app/fees per the NAV hrefs. The (app) group currently contributes NO route (layout-only) — next build is happy; the FEAT-003+ pages fill it in.
- useModuleActive currently special-cases moduleKey==='fees' for probe selection; extend the branch when new modules are added. It returns 'unknown' (shows nav) when no permitted probe exists.
- MfaEnrollment is reused verbatim via props { open, onClose } (named export). NotificationBell reused verbatim.
- auth store migrate return type is a local PersistedAuth = Pick<AuthState, persisted keys>; zustand's inferred PersistedState required Pick, not Partial (fixed a strict-tsc error vs the design's `as Partial<AuthState>`).
- Topbar shows generic 'Institution' label (never institutionId UUID) and a coarse roles[0] badge.
Verification: npm run lint -w @campusgate/web PASS (strict tsc); npm run build -w @campusgate/web PASS (next build, all 5 GatePass groups + /platform still build untouched).
